title: This is a kit that must be glued and painted.
text: This is a kit that must be glued and painted.. This is a kit that must be glued and painted. I have purchased 5 Woodland Scenics models. The other 4 were assembled and needed no painting. Very disappointed with this kit. Suggested tools: primer, paint, painting tools, plastic cement, super glue, hobby knife, sandpaper, white glue, tweezers, needle nose pliers, scissors, burnisher and newspaper. The windmill kit states you need painting tools. I thought they were talking paint brushes. Nope! You need an air brush. Cost at Amazon $49.96.

product_metadata.title: Woodland Scenics WDS5213 N Windmills
description: This is the N Scale Windmills from the Landmark Structures Series by Woodland Scenics. FEATURES Build two windmills, painted to your specifications Broken one features busted blades set on a tower of weathered wood and includes two oblong stock tanks, a hand pump and trough Other windmill is in good repair, sets high on a tall wood tower with ladder and features a round stock tank and a hay rack Two suggested footprint dimensions included Instructions included INCLUDES One N Scale Windmills REQUIREMENTS Assembly Hobby knife Cement for plastics Sprue cutters Sandpaper Paint SPECIFICATIONS Scale: N 1/160 COMMENTS Due to small parts that could cause a choking hazard please keep away from children 3 years of age and younger
